GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 095 (24 Jan 46) ESS/FI
(SCAPIN - 650)
APO 500
24 January 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : Imperial Japanese Government
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo
SUBJECT : Request of Doitsu Senryo Gomei Kaisha (German Dyestuff Co., Ltd.) to sell Dyestuffs and Chemicals to Kaseihin Tosei Kabushiki Kaisha
1. Reference is made to C.L.O. Memorandum No. 1423 (5.3) dated 28 December 1945, which inclosed application of Doitsu Senryo Gomei Kaisha requesting permission to sell dyestuffs and chemicals to Kaseihin Tosei Kabushiki Kaisha.
2. The request of Doitsu Senryo Gomei Kaisha is denied.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
/s/ H. W. Allen
/t/ H. W. ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst. Adjutant General
